_source.derived_from: ~/mission-control/lib/atlas.js (1,835 lines, read-only, static read — the live scanner was never run)
_source.method: Transcribed from the static definitions in that file: HEALTH_SERVICES, APP_SUBSYSTEMS, WIRED_DEPS, CRON_JOBS, INTERVAL_JOBS, TIERS, the six build*Tier() functions and buildEdges(). Roles were rewritten in plain English from the comments and sub-labels beside each node.
_source.caution: This is the SHAPE of the system, not its live state. The dashboard’s per-node state (up / degraded / armed / hold …) is a probe result and is deliberately not included here.

_redactions.note: Every node and edge survives — the structure is unchanged. What was removed is the identifying material carried INSIDE each node.
removed_categories: Hostnames and domains — the public-site node was labelled with the live hostname in the source; it is labelled "Public domain" here.
Internal URLs — health, version, config and status endpoint paths, and the healthcheck path configured on the host.
Ports — the local dev-server port and every listener port read from netstat.
Environment-variable / key / secret NAMES — the launch-gate, backup-schedule, bot-gate site-key and push-key variable names, and the advisory-lock key constant.
Bucket, container and object names — the backup bucket and any object path.
Account, deployment, replica and commit identifiers — deployed commit SHAs, branch names, the production ref, builder and edge-region identifiers, restart-policy values and process ids.
Absolute filesystem paths — the checkout root, the autopilot directory, the hold file, the backups directory and the changelog path.
Source-file paths and line numbers — every "src/…js:NNNN" reference that pinned a job or subsystem to a line of the private codebase.
Exact cron expressions — replaced with plain-English cadence ("once a week", "every 30 seconds").

Live probe state and timings — per-node up/down/armed state, HTTP status codes, response times, cache ages, next-fire timestamps, incident counts and the leader/follower role of whichever replica answered.
kept_on_purpose: The tier structure and every node id, because ids are generic and carry no infrastructure detail.

Generic vendor names that the product already names publicly: Cloudflare, Railway, Postgres, Clerk, Brevo, Lemon Squeezy, Backblaze B2, Google Gemini, GitHub, Discord, Google, Web push, Finnhub, Twelve Data, CoinGecko.
The fact that one job is deliberately disabled, and that one interval timer runs on every replica rather than only the leader — both are design facts, not secrets.

nodes.label: Public domain
nodes.role: The public web address the app answers on, probed with a TLS handshake and one health request.

nodes.label: Turnstile
nodes.role: Cloudflare’s bot challenge in front of the sign-up paths; the map checks only that it is armed.

nodes.label: Launch gate
nodes.role: One configured instant decides whether the public app is open; unset or malformed and it fails closed.

nodes.label: Railway service
nodes.role: The managed host running the app process, with a healthcheck path and a restart policy.

nodes.label: Leader election
nodes.role: A Postgres advisory lock elects one replica as leader; only the leader is allowed to fire the crons.

nodes.label: Boot
nodes.role: The boot chain that must finish before anything is served — a critical health component.

nodes.label: Database
nodes.role: Connection pool plus a live query check — a critical health component.

nodes.label: Scheduler
nodes.role: The cron registry; reports healthy on a follower by design, because a follower schedules nothing.

nodes.label: Webhooks
nodes.role: Inbound webhook routes mounted and ready for the billing, auth and chat providers.

nodes.label: Auth
nodes.role: Session verification against the identity provider on every authenticated request.

nodes.label: Auth key pair
nodes.role: Checks the live and test halves of the identity provider’s keys match: ok, mismatch or unknown.

nodes.label: Dashboard
nodes.role: Asset check for the signed-in app shell — a critical health component.

nodes.label: Task runs
nodes.role: The orchestration behind every task run: pick a model, fetch what the task needs, write the answer.

nodes.label: Digests + alerts
nodes.role: Run emails, daily and weekly digests, and browser push notifications.

nodes.label: Help assistant
nodes.role: Answers questions about the product from a corpus built out of the site’s own pages.

nodes.label: Billing
nodes.role: Paid subscriptions and checkout, driven by the payments provider’s webhook.

nodes.label: Inbound email
nodes.role: Reads replies to run emails so a correction typed back into an inbox refines the task.

nodes.label: Backups
nodes.role: Gzipped JSON snapshots, encrypted with AES-GCM and written off-site.

nodes.label: Supervisor
nodes.role: A meta-watchdog left in the tree on purpose but deliberately never started.

nodes.label: Dev console
nodes.role: One maintainer page for errors, health and failed runs, fed by an in-process event sink.

nodes.label: Migrations
nodes.role: Schema migrations run on boot, before the process begins serving traffic.

nodes.label: Postgres
nodes.role: The single relational database; its state is inferred from the app’s own database health field.

nodes.label: Clerk
nodes.role: Hosted identity: sessions, sign-in, and webhook signature verification.

nodes.label: Cloudflare
nodes.role: CDN, TLS and the bot gate in front of the origin; confirmed from the response headers.

nodes.label: Brevo
nodes.role: Email in and out over an HTTP API — there is no SMTP path anywhere in the app.

nodes.label: Google Gemini
nodes.role: The default model provider; a user may bring a key for another provider instead.

nodes.label: Backblaze B2
nodes.role: The off-site encrypted backup store, reached through a hand-rolled request signer.

nodes.label: Lemon Squeezy
nodes.role: Subscriptions and checkout, with a signed webhook back into the app.

nodes.label: GitHub
nodes.role: Per-user tokens for repository tasks; the supervisor would also merge here, but it is off.

nodes.label: Discord
nodes.role: Operations alerts and waitlist hooks, sent as a chat-webhook payload.

nodes.label: Google
nodes.role: OAuth plus a spreadsheet data source; per-user tokens are encrypted at rest.

nodes.label: Web push
nodes.role: VAPID browser notifications, delivered through each browser vendor’s push service.

nodes.label: Finnhub
nodes.role: Primary stock quotes for any task that names a ticker.

nodes.label: Twelve Data
nodes.role: Failover stock quotes, used when the primary rate-limits or errors.

nodes.label: CoinGecko
nodes.role: Crypto prices from a keyless public API, so it has to be paced.

nodes.label: Weekly digests
nodes.role: Fires once a week to send every account its weekly digest. Leader-elected.

nodes.label: Daily digest sweep
nodes.role: Runs every hour and sends each account its daily digest at that account’s local hour.

nodes.label: Nightly backup
nodes.role: Takes the nightly encrypted snapshot and uploads it off-site. Leader-elected.

nodes.label: Backup freshness
nodes.role: Alerts every morning if the newest backup is more than 48 hours old.

nodes.label: Task reconciler
nodes.role: Every 30 seconds, reconciles what should be scheduled against what actually is.

nodes.label: History prune
nodes.role: Once a day, trims stored run history. Leader-elected.

nodes.label: Health monitor
nodes.role: Every minute, writes the incident rows the public status endpoint reads back.

nodes.label: Supervisor sweep
nodes.role: Registered in the code but never started — shown as what would run, not as armed.

nodes.label: Per-user schedules
nodes.role: Every user’s own task schedules, registered at runtime in that user’s own timezone.

nodes.label: Local checkout
nodes.role: The working copy on Owen’s machine; the map compares its commit with what production is serving.

nodes.label: Local dev server
nodes.role: The local server that has to mirror production exactly, minus the change being built.

nodes.label: Help corpus
nodes.role: The search index the help assistant answers from; it goes stale the moment a page is edited.

nodes.label: Autopilot
nodes.role: A worker/reviewer/watchdog loop, held on manual hold; the real stop is its disabled scheduled tasks.

nodes.label: Local snapshots
nodes.role: Snapshot files on disk, checked by timestamp only — their contents are never read.

nodes.label: Changelog
nodes.role: The public release log, checked for how many commits have landed since its newest entry.
